outcome: factors that motivate women to consider planning a vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC)
cohort: A purposive sample of 18 women participating in an RCT who had experienced previous caesarean section and had no contraindications for vaginal birth.
finding: Women were committed to natural birth, highlighted the downsides of caesarean section recovery, individualized information to balance risk and chance, and found supportive healthcare providers (especially midwives) important in motivating them towards vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Recovery post caesarean section is an important consideration that is under emphasised in the informed consent process for birth mode.
cross-section timing: During the decision-making process for planning a VBAC.
